subject: Mathematics
competency_statement: Solves 4-digit addition and subtraction word problems and multiplies 2-digit numbers by 1-digit/2-digit numbers.
what_student_can_do: Calculates expenses, ticket prices, and distances using column place-value arithmetic up to 9,999.
observable_indicators: Aligns digits accurately in place-value columns up to thousands
Estimates realistic sums before calculating to detect arithmetic errors
Solves multi-step real-world money word problems
source_citation: NCF-SE 2023 Curricular Area 2 (Mathematics), Section 2.1; NCERT Curriculum Framework 2024–26

subject: Mathematics
competency_statement: Measures and converts weights between kilograms and grams, estimating everyday weights accurately.
what_student_can_do: Balances two-pan scales using standard weights and converts weights (e.g., 2 kg 450 g = 2450 g).
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on balance scale laboratory and grocery packaging audits
observable_indicators: Balances kitchen scale using 100g, 250g, 500g, and 1kg weights
Converts fractional kilogram quantities to grams without errors
Estimates weights of common school objects within 20% margin
source_citation: NCF-SE 2023 Curricular Area 2 (Mathematics), Section 2.3; NCERT Class 4 Syllabus

subject: Environmental Studies
competency_statement: Traces community water supply paths, tests basic filtration, and audits household and school water wastage.
what_student_can_do: Builds a three-layer sand-gravel filter and calculates water loss from leaking school taps.
pedagogical_approach: Guided community water walk and fair-test low-cost filtration experiment
observable_indicators: Illustrates pipeline flow from river/well to household tap
Builds an operative 3-tier plastic bottle sand/gravel filter
Computes daily tap drip wastage and drafts conservation pledge

ncert.chapter: Chapter 18: Too Much Water, Too Little Water

source_citation: NCF-SE 2023 Curricular Area 3 (Science & Social Studies Integration), Section 3.1; NCERT Looking Around Syllabus
